events.what: Nguyen, Scott, Seymour prove the Erdős–Hajnal property for the five-vertex path P5 (completing all five-vertex H)
Huang, Ju, Zhou prove the Erdős–Hajnal property for two six-vertex graphs (E-graph and Bird graph)
Single-exponential Erdős–Hajnal bound for graphs of bounded VC-dimension

judgement.doubts: The P5 result is a pre-snapshot event (v1 2023-12-23 already contained the proof; v2/journal publication is not new mathematics), so it cannot anchor the status. Status stays partial on the Huang–Ju–Zhou six-vertex cases. Steiner's odd-girth paper (arXiv:2608.02522) and arXiv:2608.28551 were not assessed as events; neither could raise the tier above partial.

outcome_prefix: Huang, Ju and Zhou (arXiv:2606.06258, 2026-06-04) prove the Erdős–Hajnal property for two six-vertex graphs, the E-graph and the Bird graph, a case of the conjecture.
